scope: Power-strip four-endpoint desk resource, visual state, device links, replacement and save/restore

checks.name: Four real appearances share one desk, state and four-endpoint contract
Each appearance loads with two real device links
Boolean state accepts on and rejects invalid input while preserving old document
Appearance replacement retains transform and both endpoint references
A claimed fourth-port route cannot be duplicated
Save and decode preserves the four-port graph and state

limits: Visual endpoints reuse the existing USB visual-link profile
No electrical simulation or USB communication
